goal: Stop sessions serialising CI and the governed review and re-pushing once per finding, by briefing them in AGENTS.md 5.0-C to start the governed review as soon as a head is pushed and to batch fixes into a single new head, and by holding that brief in place with a guard that refuses any edit turning it into a licence to review less.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues through to production
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not remove, weaken, skip or make optional any safety gate, approval requirement or required check in the name of throughput.
Do not widen the exact-head approval equivalence rule past the existing narrow .agent/ evidence exception.
Do not accept the third proposal in issue 3002; refuse it in writing instead.
assumptions: Issue 3002 states its own proposal is not yet implemented and needs a decision; the decision taken here is to parallelise and batch, and to refuse the review-equivalence widening.
The new guard script adds exactly one throughput call site, which carries its own hand-written disposition.
stop_conditions: Stop and report if the only way to hit the speed goal is to drop a safeguard.
